title: Data Engineer
description:
Andela exists to connect brilliance and opportunity. Since 2014, we have been dedicated to breaking down global barriers and accelerating the future of work for both technologists and organizations around the world. For technologists, Andela offers competitive long-term career opportunities with leading organizations, access to a global community of professionals, and educational opportunities with leading technology providers.

At Andela, we’re deeply passionate about creating long-lasting and transformative growth opportunities for all - and doing it in an E.P.I.C. way! We’re excited to continue building our remote-first team with incredible people like you. After applying for this role, you will join our Andela Community of brilliant technologists by passing a technical screening and live interview. As a community member, you’ll have access to a multitude of exclusive technologist roles.

Join Andela today to access this opportunity and more in our global marketplace!

Our roles are typically filled at lightning speed, so if you’re considering applying, get your application in quickly!



About the client

  • The client operates a global employment technology platform that connects millions of job seekers with companies through a large-scale search engine for job opportunities.
  • The organization is highly data-driven and focuses on building reliable, high-availability systems to support large volumes of traffic and data processing.
  • Their mission centers on improving access to employment through technology, analytics, and scalable infrastructure.
  • The culture emphasizes large-scale data engineering, experimentation, and operational excellence across distributed systems.


About the role

  • We are looking for a Data Engineer with strong experience in modern data platforms to support a large-scale migration initiative to Snowflake.
  • The role focuses on migrating approximately 1,000 datasets while adapting existing pipelines and workflows to a new architecture.
  • You will work with orchestration tools and cloud-based data lakes to ensure reliability, performance, and data quality.
  • The architecture is already defined internally, so the role is execution-focused and highly hands-on.
  • This position requires strong expertise in SQL, Python, and distributed data processing tools.


Responsibilities

  • Execute the migration of approximately 1,000 datasets to Snowflake.
  • Adapt and refactor existing data pipelines to align with the Snowflake architecture.
  • Develop and test pipelines using Python and Apache Airflow.
  • Support workflow orchestration, scheduling, and monitoring in Apache Airflow.
  • Ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across migrated datasets.
  • Work with data stored in AWS S3 data lakes, including partitioning and lifecycle policies.
  • Implement testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with internal teams following the predefined architecture and technical approach.
  • Work with streaming or event-driven data using Apache Kafka.
  • Support distributed processing workloads using Apache Spark.


Must have skills

  • 7+ years of experience in Data Engineering or related roles.
  • 7+ years of experience with Python (7–9 years).
  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, CTEs, window functions, performance tuning).
  • Snowflake (data modeling and pipeline integration).
  • Apache Airflow (pipeline development and orchestration).
  • Apache Spark (distributed data processing).
  • Apache Kafka.
  • AWS experience, especially S3 (data lakes, partitioning, lifecycle policies).
  • Experience in defining and implementing testing strategies for data pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining production-grade data pipelines.


Nice to have skills

  • Hands-on experience with Snowflake migrations (data warehouse modernization, performance optimization, cost optimization).
  • Experience with Apache Airflow migrations (version upgrades, executor changes, or platform migrations).


Conditions

  • Remote role (100% remote). Primary timezone: UTC-6 with at least 8 hours of overlap required.
  • Contractor role (initially 3-month contract, but renewable: expected overall duration up to 12 months).
  • Full-time dedication (40 hours/week).
  • BYOD required (bring your own device).

This commitment applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.
  • A team of about 10 people consisting of a team lead, a sw architect, a few senior developers. After your SW design is approved you are responsible for implementing the design in Python & C for new modules.
  • During testing, you will collect the necessary data so you can write a test report.
  • The development environment is Red Hat Linux, execution environment is Wind River Linux. The software release driving a client machine is 40 million lines of code. Client SW teams work in various modes such as Agile and SAFE.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • We are looking for colleagues with at least 5 years of development experience.
  • Python: application coding
  • Linux (one of more of the following): familiar with command line tools, makefile, git, shell and python scripting
  • Embedded C and C++: understanding and maintaining legacy code. Adding new features while keeping compliance with established architecture.
  • Version control using command line is also required - Git, Clear Case and SVN, in this order of priority.


Languages:

  • English: C1 Advanced

  • Habilidade para trabalhar com prazos, dados e informações sensíveis
  • Comunicação clara e habilidade para relacionamento com diferentes áreas;

  • Visão de processos e melhoria contínua;

Habilidades Preferenciais

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams.


You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
  • Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
  • Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
  • Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
  • Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
  • Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
  • Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
  • Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Senior C/C++ engineer with Python
description:
Project Description:

Founded in 1984, our client is one of the world's leading provider of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry, manufacturing complex machines that are critical to the production of integrated circuits or chips. The client has its R&D and manufacturing operations in The Netherlands.

Luxoft is currently searching to augment the Development & Engineering Department with a talented software engineer to design and implement embedded software for systems among the highest precision ever produced in the world.


Responsibilities:

  • As a software engineer, you will be working on Linux server applications for metrology components and on complex algorithms application software. You will be working with electrical engineers, mechatronic engineers and system engineers to define the software requirements.

title: Analista de Suporte de Sistemas
description:
Junte-se à transformação da saúde no Brasil com a Salux Technology!


A Salux Technology é uma HealthTech 100% brasileira pioneira em soluções inovadoras de gestão de saúde. Desde 1997, nossa missão tem sido democratizar a excelência em saúde, ajudando mais de 250 clientes em todo o país a alcançar resultados excepcionais ao aprimorar a gestão administrativa e clínica.


Em 2021, a Salux passou a fazer parte do Grupo SBPar, o que acelerou nossa jornada de expansão e inovação, consolidando nossa posição como referência em excelência na informatização e soluções tecnológicas para o setor de saúde.


Se você é movido por desafios e quer fazer a diferença em um ambiente dinâmico e em constante evolução, venha crescer conosco e impactar positivamente o futuro da saúde no Brasil!


Responsabilidades:

Atender usuários do sistema, prestando suporte de primeiro e segundo nível;

Contribuir na análise e solução de incidentes, identificando a causa dos problemas e propondo alternativas sob acompanhamento da equipe;

Acompanhar o desempenho da aplicação, auxiliando no monitoramento e na detecção de possíveis falhas;

Apoiar na manutenção e atualização de manuais e instruções de trabalho;

Garantir uma comunicação clara e objetiva com os usuários e colegas sobre o andamento dos atendimentos;

Engajar-se no aprendizado contínuo sobre os processos de negócio e sugerir ajustes que melhorem a experiência do usuário.


Requisitos:

Formação superior em andamento ou concluída em cursos da área de Tecnologia da Informação (Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou similares);

Noções de Banco de Dados, com habilidade para interpretar e executar consultas SQL simples;

Experiência prévia em suporte técnico ou no atendimento a usuários de sistemas hospitalares;

Conhecimento básico em ferramentas do pacote Office;

Facilidade de comunicação e postura orientada para o cliente;

Espírito de colaboração e capacidade de trabalho em equipe;

Proatividade, agilidade, foco em resultados e vontade de aprender.


Modalidade de contratação: CLT.

Modelo de trabalho: Atuação híbrida em nosso escritório na Zona Sul de São Paulo.


Nossos Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Technical Learning Programs


  • Location : Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) Contract | Monthly Invoicing
  • Start : ASAP | Contract through December 2026


About SureSkills

SureSkills is a global leader in technical learning and enablement, partnering with major technology organisations including Google Cloud. We design and deliver advanced cloud training programs, hands-on labs, certification pathways, and scalable technical enablement initiatives worldwide.


About the Role

This is a cross-functional, delivery-focused role supporting high-impact Google-related initiatives.


You will work closely with internal business owners across:


  • Content Development (technical workshops)
  • Technical Lab Support (hands-on learning environments)
  • Budget management and reporting


This is structured project leadership — not direct people management. The role also involves regular interaction with stakeholders at Google, requiring clear communication, structured updates, and strong alignment management.


Ideal Profile

  • 5–10 years’ experience in project management
  • Experience delivering technical, digital, or learning programs
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills
  • Comfortable engaging enterprise stakeholders
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Able to operate independently in a PJ contractor model


Backgrounds That Fit Well

  • Learning / Enablement Project Manager (technical programs)
  • Content Development PM for complex digital initiatives
  • Program Manager in consulting or partner ecosystems
  • Technical PM in cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments


What You’ll Do

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Build structured project plans and define milestones
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate lab and content development initiatives
  • Facilitate alignment meetings
  • Proactively resolve blockers

Google Stakeholder Engagement

  • Provide structured status updates
  • Clarify evolving requirements
  • Support delivery alignment between SureSkills and Google

Delivery Oversight

  • Monitor readiness of lab environments and learning assets
  • Coordinate QA and validation cycles
  • Support smooth program launch and rollout

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to scalable, repeatable delivery frameworks
  • Improve reporting, documentation, and visibility


This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to Google stakeholders and global cloud initiatives.


If you’re a structured, delivery-driven PM who enjoys working at the intersection of technology and learning, we’d love to hear from you

title: Analytics Manager
description:
Senior Operations Data Analyst

100% Remote (Brazil-Based) | US-Based Company | Paid in USD/hour


We are hiring for a leading US-based luxury resale and eCommerce company transforming how high-end fashion is bought and sold globally.


We are looking for a Senior Operations Data Analyst with a strong analytics mindset, solid SQL expertise, and proven experience working closely with business teams. This is a high-impact role focused on operational performance, business clarity, and strategic decision-making.


About the Role


You will deliver quantitative insights to support our Operations organization, partnering closely with teams across:


  • Inventory
  • Logistics
  • Retail
  • Customer Service
  • Tech & Finance


This is a business-focused analytics role, not pure research or advanced modeling. The day-to-day work includes:


  • Explaining performance changes (“why did this move?”)
  • Turning open-ended business questions into structured analysis
  • Designing and defining KPIs
  • Measuring operational efficiency across receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows
  • Translating business needs into technical solutions

You will deliver quantitative insights to support our Operations organization, partnering closely with teams across:

  • Turning open-ended business questions into structured analysis
  • Designing and defining KPIs
  • Measuring operational efficiency across receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows
  • Translating business needs into technical solutions

title: Senior Azure Cloud Architect
description:
About You

You are a senior-level Azure Cloud Architect who enjoys building secure, scalable, and automated cloud platforms. You take ownership of architectural decisions and are comfortable translating business and platform requirements into repeatable Azure foundations. You value clean design, governance, and automation, and you collaborate closely with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams.


You thrive in complex enterprise environments, communicate technical concepts clearly, and act as a technical reference for Azure architecture, networking, security, and platform automation.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience architecting and operating solutions in Microsoft Azure.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Proven experience implementing Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF) and Azure Landing Zones.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with Terraform, including modular design and remote state management.
  • Experience designing enterprise Azure architectures, including multi-subscription environments.
  • Strong experience with Azure DevOps, including YAML pipelines and CI/CD governance.
  • Solid experience designing hub-and-spoke network architectures and hybrid connectivity.
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Strong understanding of cloud security, governance, and enterprise-scale architecture.
  • Experience implementing Azure security controls, RBAC, policies, and compliance standards.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and clear technical communication.
  • Azure certifications (AZ-305, AZ-400, AZ-104, AZ-204) and/or Terraform certification (nice to have).
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Design and implement Azure tenant architectures aligned with Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and Azure Landing Zone best practices.
  • Define and manage management group hierarchies, subscription strategies, and environment separation.
  • Establish standardized patterns for identity, networking, security, governance, and logging.
  • Build and maintain Terraform-based Infrastructure as Code and integrate it into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Design and maintain multi-stage Azure DevOps pipelines for infrastructure and platform automation.
  • Architect and support enterprise networking, including hub-and-spoke topologies and hybrid connectivity.
  • Support containerized platforms using Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Implement and enforce Azure security, governance, and compliance controls.
  • Collaborate with application, DevOps, security, and infrastructure teams on platform adoption.
  • Provide technical guidance and architectural direction to engineering teams.
  • Continuously improve platform reliability, scalability, and operational excellence.


Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience designing and operating Azure cloud architectures
  • Proven experience implementing Azure Landing Zones and Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF)
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform (Infrastructure as Code)
  • Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD pipelines (YAML)
  • Advanced English proficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.

  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.

  • unblemished reputation;

  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Project Manager
description:
Project Manager – Technical Learning Programs


  • Location : Brazil (Remote)
  • Employment type: PJ (Pessoa Jurídica) Contract | Monthly Invoicing
  • Start : ASAP | Contract through December 2026


About SureSkills

SureSkills is a global leader in technical learning and enablement, partnering with major technology organisations including Google Cloud. We design and deliver advanced cloud training programs, hands-on labs, certification pathways, and scalable technical enablement initiatives worldwide.


About the Role

This is a cross-functional, delivery-focused role supporting high-impact Google-related initiatives.


You will work closely with internal business owners across:


  • Content Development (technical workshops)
  • Technical Lab Support (hands-on learning environments)
  • Budget management and reporting


This is structured project leadership — not direct people management. The role also involves regular interaction with stakeholders at Google, requiring clear communication, structured updates, and strong alignment management.


Ideal Profile

  • 5–10 years’ experience in project management
  • Experience delivering technical, digital, or learning programs
  • Strong cross-functional coordination skills
  • Comfortable engaging enterprise stakeholders
  • Strong written and spoken English
  • Able to operate independently in a PJ contractor model


Backgrounds That Fit Well

  • Learning / Enablement Project Manager (technical programs)
  • Content Development PM for complex digital initiatives
  • Program Manager in consulting or partner ecosystems
  • Technical PM in cloud, SaaS, or infrastructure environments


What You’ll Do

Program Planning & Coordination

  • Build structured project plans and define milestones
  • Manage timelines, risks, and dependencies
  • Ensure alignment across multiple workstreams

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate lab and content development initiatives
  • Facilitate alignment meetings
  • Proactively resolve blockers

Google Stakeholder Engagement

  • Provide structured status updates
  • Clarify evolving requirements
  • Support delivery alignment between SureSkills and Google

Delivery Oversight

  • Monitor readiness of lab environments and learning assets
  • Coordinate QA and validation cycles
  • Support smooth program launch and rollout

Process Improvement

  • Contribute to scalable, repeatable delivery frameworks
  • Improve reporting, documentation, and visibility


This is a high-visibility role with direct exposure to Google stakeholders and global cloud initiatives.


If you’re a structured, delivery-driven PM who enjoys working at the intersection of technology and learning, we’d love to hear from you

title: Analytics Manager
description:
Senior Operations Data Analyst

100% Remote (Brazil-Based) | US-Based Company | Paid in USD/hour


We are hiring for a leading US-based luxury resale and eCommerce company transforming how high-end fashion is bought and sold globally.


We are looking for a Senior Operations Data Analyst with a strong analytics mindset, solid SQL expertise, and proven experience working closely with business teams. This is a high-impact role focused on operational performance, business clarity, and strategic decision-making.


About the Role


You will deliver quantitative insights to support our Operations organization, partnering closely with teams across:


  • Inventory
  • Logistics
  • Retail
  • Customer Service
  • Tech & Finance


This is a business-focused analytics role, not pure research or advanced modeling. The day-to-day work includes:


  • Explaining performance changes (“why did this move?”)
  • Turning open-ended business questions into structured analysis
  • Designing and defining KPIs
  • Measuring operational efficiency across receiving, authentication, launch, and outbound workflows
  • Translating business needs into technical solutions

title: Senior Software Developer (React.js / Node.js)
description:
We are looking for a remote, full-time Senior Software Developer with 5+ years of software development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js to join our U.S. client's engineering team. You will lead, develop and enhance SaaS products used by thousands of customers. The right candidate is self-driven with a strong understanding of the software development lifecycle who wants to make an impact on technology that reaches customers and consumers globally.

The ideal candidate has strong experience working with technical onshore, offshore, and nearshore teams along with modern cloud-based platforms particularly within the AWS, Salesforce, Linode, and Heroku ecosystem, and is comfortable leading and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision-making.

Our client provides innovative software solutions for automobile retailers having lead the market since 2014. With over 6,000 customers across North America, the company enhances the buying experience with cutting-edge software that eases communication and converts interest into purchases. Backed by private equity, the company's software features span website conversion, sales enablement, service offers management, retention marketing, and communication through the lenses of valuations, payments, inventory merchandising, and video.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, development, and maintenance of complex web applications using TypeScript, React.js, and Node.js, ensuring high-quality code standards and architectural best practices
  • Mentor junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable software solutions
  • Drive technical decision-making for system architecture, technology stack choices, and development processes while maintaining comprehensive documentation and testing strategies
  • Follow agile software development processes, collaborating with both onshore and offshore teams
  • Contribute to the development of cloud-based software using Node.js, React.js, TypeScript, Salesforce APEX and Lightning, PostgreSQL, AWS, MongoDB,.NET, PHP, RoR, Python, ETL/Data feeds, and Heroku
  • Continuously learn and adopt new technologies to improve product functionality


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communications skills
  • 5-10+ years of professional software development experience
  • Experience with expertise in TypeScript, React, Node.js, and modern JavaScript frameworks and libraries
  • Experience in Salesforce Lightning and SLDS, APEX, Batch, External Client Apps (Connected App), Remote setting, Salesforce Revenue Cloud with legacy applications and NetSuite
  • Experience in Business intelligence QuickSight developers, ETL process, and data extraction
  • Strong proficiency in database design and management (Salesforce Objects and triggers, MongoDB, SQL), RESTful API development, and cloud services integration with experience in CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience in leading software product development projects
  • Hands on experience leading technical teams both onshore, offshore & nearshore
  • Working under limited supervision and developing code for new business features based on functional and technical specs
  • Decomposes features for a sprint team in to tasks that can be accomplished inside of a sprint; Provides work BPLOE for tasks
  • Understands and adheres to the area's software lifecycle process

  • Learns and utilizes new technologies as required, serves as an expert technical resource, advisor, and mentor in one or more feature sets or technologies supported by development team
  • Provides technical mentorship and work task direction to a team of developers; able to fill the Technical Owner role on an agile sprint team, holding people accountable for task delivery
  • Works with product management to groom and select Features for their area to be included in upcoming releases
  • Comfortable working within a fast-paced environment
  • Self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent

  • Knowledge of authentication systems (OAuth/OICS, OWASP security best practices including rate limiting and data encryption

title: Analista de suprimentos Sênior
description:
RESUMO DO CARGO


O Analista de Compras de categorias é responsável por conduzir processos de aquisição de materiais e serviços, assegurando o atendimento eficiente às demandas das áreas internas. Atua em todas as etapas do processo de compras, garantindo conformidade com as políticas da empresa, agilidade na entrega e otimização de custos. Deve manter relacionamento ativo com fornecedores e apoiar estratégias de suprimentos, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua dos processos e performance da área.


RESPONSABILIDADES


  • Cumprir e promover as Políticas da Empresa relacionadas a meio ambiente, saúde e segurança, qualidade, compliance, ética, entre outras.
  • Atuar em conformidade com a Política de Suprimentos, procedimentos internos e legislação vigente.
  • Garantir a conformidade com normas ISO (9001, 14001, 45001), FSSC 22000 e SOX.
  • Evidenciar e registrar todo o processo de compra nos sistemas da empresa (SAP, COUPA, etc.).
  • Apoiar auditorias internas e externas, incluindo apresentação de documentação de suporte.
  • Conduzir reuniões com requisitantes para acompanhamento de demandas e antecipação de necessidades.
  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo do processo de compras (Purchase-to-Pay).
  • Monitorar e apresentar os principais KPIs da área, como savings, SLA de atendimento, compliance e lead time.
  • Atuar como facilitador para a resolução de problemas nos processos de compras e pagamentos.
  • Negociar condições comerciais com fornecedores de acordo com as estratégias de sourcing.
  • Emitir pedidos de compra e elaborar contratos via sistema (SAP/COUPA).
  • Apoiar ou liderar negociações contratuais junto à área jurídica.
  • Implementar contratos globais e apoiar a elaboração de budget junto aos requisitantes.
  • Realizar visitas técnicas a unidades da empresa e fornecedores.
  • Avaliar e monitorar fornecedores conforme os procedimentos internos.
  • Buscar e desenvolver novas fontes de suprimentos e alternativas de produtos e serviços.
  • Apoiar o processo de homologacão de novos produtos e serviços.
  • Cadastrar e atualizar dados de fornecedores, materiais, serviços e clientes em SAP.
  • Atuar como guardião do portal de Master Data, garantindo a governança dos dados.
  • Gerenciar processos de importação e exportação, incluindo logística, embarque, desembaraço aduaneiro e entrega final.


Pré-requisitos

1) Pacote Office Excel intermediário/avançado

2) Sistema ERP: SAP Modulo MM

3) Técnicas de Negociação


Sobre a Ardagh

A Ardagh Metal Packaging (AMP) é uma das líderes globais na produção e venda de embalagens de alumínio para bebidas, com 3 unidades de produção no Brasil - fábricas de latas em Jacareí (SP) e Alagoinhas (BA) e uma fábrica de tampas de Manaus (AM) – e um escritório localizado em São Paulo. Globalmente, a AMP opera 24 instalações de produção nas Américas e Europa, empregando cerca de 5.800 funcionários e registrou receitas de US $ 4 bilhões em 2021. A inclusão, confiança, trabalho em equipe e excelência são nossos valores e junto com o talento que buscamos, serão a fórmula perfeita para crescermos juntos!


Somos apaixonados por sustentabilidade e temos uma ótima reputação pela inovação e qualidade que oferecemos a nossos clientes. Nós somos pioneiros em novos métodos de produção, novas técnicas de design e novas formas de reciclar e economizar energia. Nosso objetivo é reduzir os impactos ambientais, enquanto permanecemos economicamente sustentáveis e socialmente responsáveis.

title: Projetista Civil - Hidrologia e Drenagem
description:
A Empower Engenharia é uma empresa especializada em projetos, acompanhamento de obras e serviços técnicos em geral para Energias Renováveis, Indústrias e Obras de Infraestrutura. Fundada em 2021, mas já referência no mercado, nosso portfolio inclui alguns dos maiores projetos e clientes do Brasil.


Nossos valores são o profissionalismo, a competência técnica, inovação, otimização, customização e atendimento ao cliente.


Neste momento a empresa busca profissionais para reforçar a equipe de projetos de Engenharia Civil, mais especificamente na área de hidrologia e drenagem superficial.


Responsabilidades e tarefas


• Elaboração de estudos hidrológicos e pluviométricos a partir de informações do INMET, ANA e outras bases oficiais.

• Desenvolvimento de projetos básicos e executivos de drenagem superficial de grandes áreas (acima de 200 hectares), com uso de método racional, ferramentas computacionais e outras metodologias consagradas.

• Dimensionamento hidráulico de dispositivos de drenagem como sarjetas, valetas, bueiros e galerias.

• Análise de estudos geológico-geotécnicos.

• Participação em reuniões.

• Visitas técnicas eventuais.


Requisitos


• Bom repertório técnico.

• Capacidade de organizar e controlar fluxos de informações.

• Facilidade de aprendizado.

• Busca pela melhoria contínua de processos.

• Ensino técnico concluído ou superior cursando em Técnico de Edificações ou Engenharia Civil.

• AutoCAD Civil 3D.

• Experiência superior a 12 meses em elaboração de projetos desta natureza.

• Inglês intermediário.


Condições de Contratação


• Local de trabalho: Belo Horizonte/MG.

• Modalidade CLT.

• Plano de saúde coparticipativo.

• Vale-alimentação ou refeição.

• Vale-transporte ou combustível.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Risk Management Officer
description:
About Us

Established in March 2018, Bybit is one of the fastest growing cryptocurrency derivatives exchanges, with more than 70 million registered users. We offer a professional platform where crypto traders can find an ultra-fast matching engine, excellent customer service and multilingual community support. We provide innovative online spot and derivatives trading services, mining and staking products, as well as API support, to retail and institutional clients around the world, and strive to be the most reliable exchange for the emerging digital asset class.


Our core values define us. We listen, care, and improve to create a faster, fairer, and more humane trading environment for our users. Our innovative, highly advanced, user-friendly platform has been designed from the ground-up using best-in-class infrastructure to provide our users with the industry's safest, fastest, fairest, and most transparent trading experience. Built on customer-centric values, we endeavour to provide a professional, 24/7 multi-language customer support to help in a timely manner.


As of today, Bybit is one of the most trusted, reliable, and transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
  • Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
  • Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
  • Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
  • Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
  • Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
  • Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
  • Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
  • Net-worth monitoring;
  • Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
  • Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
  • Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
  • Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.


Requirements:

  • Legally resident in Brazil.
  • Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
  • Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function.
  • Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements.
  • Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
  • Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English .
  • Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including:
  • not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
  • unblemished reputation;
  • knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
  • technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
  • not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS) - HOME OFFICE
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer (zOS Automation and CA OPS/MVS) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer to lead the migration and optimization of mainframe automation solutions. This role focuses on transitioning from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and from CA Automation Point to IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) . The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring operational efficiency, system availability, and seamless automation processes within a complex z/OS environment.


You will collaborate closely with the Automation team to implement policy-based automation solutions, reduce administrative overhead, and enhance system responsiveness. This position does not impact application development but will significantly influence automation strategies and operations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Lead migration projects from CA OPS/MVS to IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS and CA Automation Point to IBM SAIOM.
  • Configure and implement IBM Systems Automation solutions, including policy-based automation for z/OS environments.
  • Develop and maintain automation rules, REXX execs, and System Automation Policy Database (PDB) configurations.
  • Provide installation and configuration assistance for IBM automation products.
  • Collaborate with operations teams to optimize system startup, shutdown, and recovery processes.
  • Ensure high availability and efficiency of critical systems through proactive automation strategies.
  • Document processes, configurations, and migration steps; deliver clear communication to stakeholders.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve automation-related issues in production environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in a mainframe operations environment in an operational, service, consultancy, or support role.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Advanced knowledge and hands-on experience.
  • TSO and ISPF: Proficient in using these tools for system management.
  • JCL: Strong skills in Job Control Language.
  • REXX Programming: Ability to write and maintain REXX scripts.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Working knowledge required.
  • Migration Experience: Proven track record in z/OS automation migration projects.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experience in implementing and using this product.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of other IBM Z software, including system operation, configuration, and automation.
  • Familiarity with z/OS system startup and shutdown processes.
  • Experience with SMP/E for software installation and maintenance.
  • Understanding of competing automation products in the mainframe space.
  • Expertise in fully automated system configurations on IBM Z.

title: Comprador
description:
Comprador (Foco em Contratação Internet e Conectividade)


Objetivo:  Buscar, negociar e contratar serviços de internet para escolas em todo o Brasil, garantindo o melhor preço e a instalação no prazo.



Responsabilidades:

  • Pesquisa de Mercado:  Localizar provedores de internet (ISPs) em diferentes cidades e estados.
  • Negociação Direta:  Obter orçamentos competitivos, negociando valores e condições de pagamento.
  • Seleção de Fornecedores:  Analisar qual empresa oferece o melhor custo-benefício para a necessidade da escola.
  • Formalização:  Conferir a documentação dos fornecedores e garantir que o contrato seja assinado sem erros.

title: Analista Administração de Pessoal Jr
description:
Analista de Administração de Pessoal Jr (Benefícios e Ponto Eletrônico)


  • Colher marcações dos relógios de ponto, aprovar solicitações de ajustes/marcações semanalmente, bem como acompanhar as inconsistências, validar extensões de jornada, e sinalizar aos gestores a respeito dos prazos de fechamento do ponto;
  • Controlar os espelhos de pontos, realizando conferência, analisando o apontamento dos colaboradores, garantindo assinatura e validação dos colaboradores e gestores, bem como encerrar o processamento sistêmico viabilizando informações para o cálculo da folha de pagamento;
  • Preparar e enviar relatório mensal do saldo de Banco de Horas e Horas Extras, com a provisão do valor a pagar, apoiando a administração do saldo pelos gestores, contribuindo com a redução das horas a pagar, garantindo o pagamento conforme prazo e condições estabelecidos em CLT, Convenção Coletiva ou Acordo Coletivo;
  • Criar, revisar e validar processos, procedimentos e políticas, referente ao controle de Jornada dos Colaboradores;
  • Realizar a atualização de cadastro de benefícios, inclusões e exclusões, no sistema eletrônico mensalmente visando o correto fornecimento;
  • Realizar pedido de benefícios de acordo com a unidade (Vale Transporte, Fretado, Vale Refeição e Alimentação, Assistência Médica e Odontológica, Seguro de Vida, Convênio Farmácia, e demais benefícios que fazem parte da unidade) mensalmente em sistema eletrônico, gerando relatórios de controle para conferência e respectiva autorização de pagamento, garantindo a conferência dos descontos viabilizado em folha de pagamento;
  • Realizar o lançamento de Notas Fiscais em sistema eletrônico de todos os produtos de benefícios (vale-transporte, vale-refeição, assistência médica e odontológica, seguro de vida etc.) e outras despesas do setor, bem como acompanhar aprovações, garantindo o pagamento aos fornecedores/parceiros;
  • Prestar atendimento as demandas de reembolso, verificação de rede de atendimento e realizar tratativas junto à corretora/operadoras dos contratos;
  • Realizar o levantamento de débitos de benefícios por ocasião da demissão de colaborador;
  • Manter atualizadas as informações de reajustes e regras contratuais, atualizando dados de relatórios e cadastros em sistema informatizado, facilitando o atendendo aos colaboradores e tomadas de decisões;
  • Acompanhar estratégias de mercados, realizando benchmarking, buscando e comparando melhores práticas por outras organizações;
  • Criar, revisar e validar processos, procedimentos e políticas, para a concessão e negociação de contratos de benefícios, assegurando os melhores custos e qualidade.


Requisitos:

  • Formação em Administração, Gestão de RH ou áreas afins;
  • Noções da Legislação Trabalhista, Administração de Benefícios, Ponto Eletrônico e Excel Intermediário.


Desejável:

  • Experiência com sistema Protheus;
  • Pacote Office (Intermediário);



Benefícios:

Assistência Médica, Assistência Odontológica, Vale Alimentação, Refeição na empresa, Rota, Seguro de Vida, Wellhub.


Modalidade presencial em Manaus - AM
